verdict.rationale: Runtime probes show a live first-party remote MCP server at mcp.reclaim.ai, auth-gated via spec-compliant OAuth discovery advertising read/write/mcp scopes, so an agent channel plausibly exists. However, no vendor documentation describes the server or its tools, no OpenAPI spec was found, and nothing shows that availability checks, booking, rescheduling, or cancellation are exposed to agents; the scheduling features in the docs are all dashboard or calendar-driven. Missing for 10: documented MCP/API tool list, evidenced availability-check, book, reschedule and cancel operations via API/MCP, public API reference, hands-on end-to-end agent corroboration.
